clips.text: It's a fish. It can swim.
It's a bird. It can fly.
It's a frog. It can jump!
It's a head. Touch your head!
It's a nose. Touch your nose!
It's a mouth. Open your mouth!
It's a hand. Clap your hands!
It's a leg. I've got two legs.
It's a foot. I've got two feet.
It's an arm. Wave your arms!
It's a tummy. Touch your tummy!
It's a teddy bear. I love my teddy!
It's a kite. It can fly!
It's an apple. I like apples!
It's a hat. Put on your hat!
It's a jacket. Put on your jacket!
It's a bed. Time for bed!
It's a chair. Sit down, please!
It's a door. Open the door!
It's a room. It's my room!
It's a flower. For you, Mum!
It's a book. Open your book!
It's a bag. My school bag!
What's your name? My name's Anna
How are you? I'm fine, thank you.
How old are you? I'm six.
What colour is it? It's red.
Can I have the ball, please?
Can I have the ball, please? Here you are.
Simon says, run on the spot!
Black and white, orange and brown —
Clap your hands and sit down!
One, two, three — jump with me!
Four, five, six — clap, clap, clap!
One, two, three — look at me!
Four, five, six — hands in your lap!
This is my head, this is my nose,
These are my ears — and here it goes:
Eyes and mouth, face and hair,
Hands up high in the air!
A ball, a doll, a car, a train —
Let's play, let's play, let's play again!
My teddy bear is big, my ball is small,
I like my toys — I like them all!
Walk, walk, walk — run, run, run!
Clap and dance and sing with me,
Swim, swim, swim in the sea!
Now sit down… and sleep. Shh!
Ice cream, cake — yum, yum, yum!
Eggs and pears — in my tum!
Socks and shoes on my feet,
Hat and scarf and gloves for snow —
In my house there is a room,
In my room there is a bed,
A table, a chair, a sofa too —
Home, sweet home for me and you!
The sun is hot — hot, hot, hot!
The snow is cold — brrr, brrr, brrr!
Drip, drop — the rain is here,
A rainbow in the sky — hooray!
A book, a pen, a pencil too,
Crayons red and yellow and blue!
In my bag — one, two, three,
Off to school — come with me!
How are you? — I'm fine, thank you.
What colour is it? — It's blue.
How old are you? — I'm six.
Can I have an apple, please?
